sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We have carefully reviewed your counter-offer and welcome the proposal for a 24-month contract, which provides valuable stability for both sides. For our primary Angebot, we can present a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

However, as a family-run business, extending payment terms to 60 days is not feasible for us, but we are prepared to compromise at 45 days. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €52.00 per unit, with a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei

move.body: As you confirmed in your last message, your approval covers the 48 to 50 EUR band for this part. Taking that as our shared basis, our revised position follows.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

Over the years, our family foundry has built a partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH based on trust, craftsmanship, and mutual respect. We value our long-standing relationship and negotiate based on facts and actual cost structures, not unfounded claims.

Our current offer stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 60 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Therefore, our offer of €52.20 for a 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms remains our position. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

We stand proudly behind the quality of our work and look forward to continuing our collaboration.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. Our pricing is based on actual cost structures and the high quality of our craftsmanship, not on unfounded assertions. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Therefore, our offer of €52.20 for a 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms remains our position.

To be precise, our offer stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

It has always been a matter of pride for our family foundry to maintain long-standing relationships built on mutual trust and uncompromised quality. We value our connection with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH deeply and trust you understand that our position reflects the dedication and craft of our workers.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
